content.comment_body: Hello Team, Could you please confirm if all Modbus TCP/IP controllers are compatible with [product_name] software when using [product_name] protocol devices? Additionally, is it possible to control a MODBUS TCP/IP controller using this software? Please provide advice and guidance.

[product_name] (FS01-FS03) cannot communicate with Modbus. [product_name] (FS04-FS06) can communicate with Modbus TCP/IP devices. [product_name] (FS01) is also compatible with Modbus TCP/IP. None of the [product_name] (0BA8) devices can communicate with Modbus RTU.

Thank you for your suggestions. We have [product_name] FS4, which can communicate with a Modbus RTU controller by using an RTU to TCP/IP converter. Likewise, third-party Modbus controllers should be controllable from [product_name] FS4 using [product_name] software [version_no]. Please provide additional guidance.
Could you be more specific about what information you need? Your request for assistance is quite broad.

Requesting further details: Thank you for your input. Can [product_name] FS4 communicate with a Modbus RTU controller using an RTU to TCP/IP converter? Similarly, can a third-party Modbus controller be operated with [product_name] FS4 via [product_name] software [version_no]?

I'm not certain if a Modbus TCP/IP to Modbus RTU converter will work, as I haven't tested one before. For [product_name] 8.FS4, at minimum you need [product_name] software version [version_no]. If you have [version_no], it should work. You can also upgrade for free to the latest [version_no].

It seems possible to connect Modbus RTU to [product_name] with Modbus TCP/IP capability, but there are a few challenges: 1. Users who've tested RTU to TCP/IP converters rarely share their results, so it's hard to confirm if the setup works; 2. It's difficult to find related information in forums or online resources. Regards, [user_name]
Hello, There's an online training module available from [company_name] covering Modbus and NTP synchronization: [document]. Hope this is useful.
Are you certain that the provided resources include information about Modbus?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are searching for confirmation and advice regarding compatibility between [product_name] software and [product_name] modules (specifically FS4 versions) for communication with Modbus TCP/IP and Modbus RTU controllers, particularly with RTU to TCP/IP converter usage. There is some ambiguity around software and hardware version requirements, as well as a noticeable absence of reliable documentation or user testimonials about successful RTU to TCP/IP integration. This lack of clarity leads to a sense of uncertainty when attempting to integrate third-party Modbus devices.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect thorough guidance on the compatibility, configuration process, and steps required for successful integration between [product_name] software ([version_no]) and [product_name] modules (FS4) with third-party Modbus TCP/IP and RTU controllers through protocol converters.
